summary: Product weekly, March 25. Alex (Product) shared that activation is now 55% — up from 45% last month. Product defines activation as a user who completes onboarding (profile + first project created). Alex said the onboarding redesign is working. Finance also mentioned ARR: Sales is reporting RM13.1M including committed contracts still in trial, while Finance reports RM12.4M excluding trials. Both called it ARR.
